plugins.name: reviewer
plugins.description: Multi-agent code review with scored issues. /reviewer:review runs parallel review agents (bug hunter, guidelines, error/edges, architecture, tests) plus project-specific domain agents for Strimma, Springa, and Garmin CIQ.
